prior_fixed_gate.interpretation: Direct matched source design does not cover enough independent taxa/studies for a proposed macro genetic-vs-phenotypic rate comparison.

scientific_caveats: Source PROCEED Genphen=Genetic denotes measurement intended to capture heritable phenotypic differences, not independently measured adaptation or reciprocal-transplant fitness.
Phenotypic refers to total field phenotype and mixes genetic and environmental components; source category contrast alone is not a plasticity reaction norm.
Even strict same-study/site/trait matches do not prove the same genotypes, measurement conditions or causal population histories.
No original genetic/phenotypic rate magnitude, fitness outcome or climatic predictor association was read or fitted in this eligibility audit.
Keep the separate 70-species heritable-phenotypic change RATE prediction program candidate, but do not claim adaptation/plasticity decomposition or speciation.
